svg.title: Luke Collins: deepfake detection researcher who ships production systems.
svg.desc: Luke Collins's name, drawn as red, green and blue channels that drift apart and lock back into register. Beside it, an abstract face-mesh constellation inside detection brackets with the readout p(synthetic) = 0.03, and a frequency spectrum with a slow sweep. Roles: PhD candidate at Deakin University, Managing Director of Dynamis Group, lead maintainer of DFWB.
svg.text: PhD candidate · Deakin University / Managing Director · Dynamis Group / Lead maintainer · DFWB
